verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents in-product AI features that work on user data: AI commit message suggestions generated from project changes, and AI-assisted mock server generation from prompts, OpenAPI definitions, or live URL responses. Neither feature offers analytical insights into the user's API data, such as responses, test results, or specs, so only a narrow slice of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: AI analysis or insights over request/response or test data, AI suggestions for improving specs or requests, depth documentation of the AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
